title: Session Fixation in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. (CVE-2026-78114)
description: A session fixation vulnerability exists in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. The session identifier is not replaced upon user authentication, allowing an attacker who sets a known session ID in a victim's browser to reuse that session after login. This issue is fixed in versions 3.0.1 and 2.12.6.
